Austrian Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Austria comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Austrian documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Bezirkshauptmannschaft or Magistrat180–650 EUR
Driving Licencethe Bezirkshauptmannschaft or Magistrat130–500 EUR
ID Cardthe Bezirkshauptmannschaft90–310 EUR
Green Cardthe Bezirkshauptmannschaft330–1050 EUR
Visaan Austrian embassy155–540 EUR
Residence Permitthe Bezirkshauptmannschaft315–930 EUR

Two checks specific to Austria

  • Check the licence for the EU category grid and confirm the issuing district is named on the card.
  • Confirm the passport eagle printing and the machine-readable zone check digits.

Local red flag

  • A document listing Vienna as the district on a card with a Linz address.
